newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle lightly tested - USDA.

text.p: Live Sales Compared to Tuesday - Slaughter steers and heifers lightly tested, few sales steady. Trade light to moderate. Demand moderate. Seller interest moderate to good. Offerings current.
